name: embedded-agents
description: A team of subagents for learning and building embedded projects: ESP-IDF source librarian, firmware engineer, embedded C reviewer, bench camera eye, multimeter technician, build/flash/monitor operator, lesson author, examiner with spaced recall, and a project architect. The coach (guided-learning) stays in the main session and delegates to them. Includes the sysview-trace skill: SEGGER SystemView task timelines for any ESP-IDF v6 FreeRTOS project, recorded over JTAG with Espressif's official tooling only (esp_sysview, apptrace, OpenOCD).
